title: Structure and rational engineering of the PglX methyltransferase and specificity factor for BREX phage defence
authors: Went SC; Picton DM; Morgan RD; Nelson A; Dryden DT; Smith DL; Wenner N; Hinton JCD; Blower TR
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构解析PglX甲基转移酶与DNA模拟物Ocr的复合物，研究BREX系统对非回文DNA基序的识别机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构生物学研究，但未涉及AI或物理模拟方法，且对象为细菌防御系统而非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Bacteria have evolved a broad range of systems that provide defence against their viral predators, bacteriophages. Bacteriophage Exclusion (BREX) systems recognize and methylate 6 bp non-palindromic motifs within the host genome, and prevent replication of non-methylated phage DNA that encodes these same motifs. How BREX recognizes cognate motifs has not been fully understood. We have characterised BREX from pathogenic Salmonella and generated the first X-ray crystallographic structures of the conserved BREX protein, PglX. The PglX N-terminal domain encodes the methyltransferase, whereas the C-terminal domain is for motif recognition. We also present the structure of PglX bound to the phage-derived DNA mimic, Ocr, an inhibitor of BREX activity. Our analyses propose modes for DNA-binding by PglX and indicate that larger BREX complexes are required for methyltransferase activity and defence. Through rational engineering of PglX, we broadened both the range of phages targeted, and the host motif sequences that are methylated by BREX. Our data demonstrate that PglX is the sole specificity factor for BREX activity, providing motif recognition for both phage defence and host methylation.
abstract_zh: 细菌已进化出广泛的系统来防御其病毒捕食者——噬菌体。噬菌体排斥（BREX）系统识别并甲基化宿主基因组中的6 bp非回文基序，并阻止编码这些相同基序的非甲基化噬菌体DNA的复制。BREX如何识别同源基序尚未完全理解。我们表征了来自致病性沙门氏菌的BREX，并生成了保守BREX蛋白PglX的首个X射线晶体结构。PglX的N端结构域编码甲基转移酶，而C端结构域负责基序识别。我们还展示了PglX与噬菌体来源的DNA模拟物Ocr（一种BREX活性抑制剂）结合的结构。我们的分析提出了PglX结合DNA的模式，并表明更大的BREX复合物是甲基转移酶活性和防御所必需的。通过对PglX的理性工程改造，我们拓宽了靶向噬菌体的范围以及BREX甲基化的宿主基序序列。我们的数据表明，PglX是BREX活性的唯一特异性因子，为噬菌体防御和宿主甲基化提供基序识别。
